skills.name: quick_stats
skills.description: Quick statistics for data inside MindAtlas only, such as entries, tags, types, and dashboard-level totals. Do not use this for summarizing external companies, projects, or people.
intentExamples: How many entries do I have in MindAtlas?
How many tags and types do I have?
What's my total entry count right now?

skills.name: smart_capture
skills.description: Smart entry creation for saving user-provided content into MindAtlas. Use this when the user wants to create, add, save, record, or store something, or when they directly provide content that should be captured.
intentExamples: Please save what I learned about Python today
Save the following as a note: ...
Create a new task: submit the report next Monday
Today I learned about the new features in React 19

skills.name: periodic_review
skills.description: Periodic review and analysis across a time range in MindAtlas, such as generating weekly reviews, monthly reviews, or retrospectives. The user should imply or specify a time range like last week, this month, or a concrete date range.
intentExamples: Review my MindAtlas entries from last week and generate a weekly report
Retrospect on what I recorded this month
Show me my learning progress for this week

skills.name: general_chat
skills.description: Default fallback conversation when no other skill matches. Supports knowledge Q&A, summarization, writing help, translation, and similar tasks. It may use knowledge-base retrieval results, but it should not perform write/create actions by default.
